criteria.text: The launcher must not start/reuse a competing :4000 server for this workflow, and must ensure :4000/:4001/:4096 state is safe before launch.
criteria.test_id: issue-dev-smoke-launcher-c1: does not run a competing :4000 server and preflights fixed ports

criteria.text: The launcher must build or accept/stage the fork at apps/api_server/opencode_bin/opencode, make it executable, and verify its version is not the stale system 1.14.40.
criteria.test_id: issue-dev-smoke-launcher-c2: stages the supplied fork first, executable, with verified identity

criteria.text: A staged or resolved engine reporting the stale system version 1.14.40 must abort the smoke before Rhythm launches.
criteria.test_id: issue-dev-smoke-launcher-c3: rejects the stale system engine version

criteria.text: The launcher must launch the Debug app from a path that preserves repo discovery (not /private/tmp).
criteria.test_id: issue-dev-smoke-launcher-c4: launches the repo Debug bundle without a temporary copy

criteria.text: After launch, http://localhost:4001/opencode/health must report ready before the launcher reports a valid engine smoke.
criteria.test_id: issue-dev-smoke-launcher-c5: requires app-owned :4001 opencode health readiness

criteria.text: After launch, the process listening on :4096 must resolve to apps/api_server/opencode_bin/opencode.
criteria.test_id: issue-dev-smoke-launcher-c6: requires :4096 to be owned by the staged fork executable

criteria.text: After launch, the running :4096 engine version identity must match the freshly staged fork build.
criteria.test_id: issue-dev-smoke-launcher-c7: requires the running engine build identity to match

criteria.text: After launch, http://localhost:4001/agents/capabilities must report "opencode": true.
criteria.test_id: issue-dev-smoke-launcher-c8: requires opencode capability before reporting success
